answers.question: Should a new repair job be created?
answers.answer: No. It is the same fault as open ticket R-4801 with a visit already booked. Creating another would duplicate it.

answers.question: What do you reply to the tenant?
answers.answer: I confirmed the existing job and the 15 Oct 8am-12pm visit. I said her update was added and that we'd ask for a sooner slot, without promising one. I gave isolating-valve and bowl advice, asked if the date suits, and said she'll hear from us by 12 Oct.

args.body: Hello Amelia, thanks for letting us know. Your dripping tap is already logged (ref R-4801) and Swift Plumbing & Heating are booked to visit on Thursday 15 October, 8am-12pm. I haven't opened a second job, but I've added your update that it's now dripping constantly to the existing one and will ask the plumber if they can come sooner. I'll only confirm a new date once they agree it. In the meantime, if there's a small valve on the pipe under the sink, you can turn it off to stop the drip, and a bowl underneath will help. If water ever starts running or leaking elsewhere, please tell us straight away. Is the 15th still OK for you? You'll hear from us again by Monday 12 October.
